tpl.task:
[INPUT ARCHITECTURE]
You are provided with (Technical Color Mask): A clean, flat-color segment layer using target HEX keys to define material boundaries in a panoramic {ASPECT} aspect ratio.

[TASK MISSION]
Synthesize the reference image to perform a photorealistic image-to-image architectural generation pass. Translate this composition into an ultra-high-end interior photograph in the style of Dezeen and ArchDaily. 
The colors, lines, wireframe vectors, and flat-clay aesthetics exist solely to assign geometry and material boundaries. The final rendered photograph must contain exclusively physical, tactile textures. Completely remove, erase, and overwrite all mask colors, black outlines, wireframes, and synthetic untextured flat-clay surfaces.
tpl.cam: Camera & Rendering Specifications: The style of the image, make it look like shot during (Sunlit Afternoon) on a Fujifilm X100V, 23mm f/2 lens, Classic Negative film simulation; introducing hard, documentary-style contrast with rich, deeply saturated ochres, warm wood tones, and cool, cyan-tinted shadow spaces; emulating classic Superia organic film grain matrix structures with a distinct nostalgic tonal shift.
tpl.rules:
[CRITICAL REMOVAL BOUNDS]
When reading the mask, identify regions by their targeted HEX code, including minor near-match color variations that fall within a close range of the specified values. If any hex code becomes distorted or confusing, cross-reference and verify the region by its corresponding color name listed in the map below; prioritize whichever identifier correctly resolves the layout boundary to ensure flawless surface mapping, and apply only the photographic finishes listed under the final design specifications to those corresponding regions.

- Isolate layout boundaries cleanly using the multi-layer target identifiers below. The hex codes designate exact mask fields:
tpl.intro:
- TACTILE FINISH & ARCHITECTURAL SURFACE SPECIFICATIONS
Execute each material with pristine surface clarity. Maintain accurate physical scale and material roughness transitions:
tpl.lock:
FIXED GEOMETRIC ANCHORING (LOCKED STRUCTURE)
 - Preserve the supplied image's camera position, perspective, crop, {ASPECT} aspect ratio, image boundaries, room dimensions, architectural structure, cabinet layout, door/drawer/panel divisions, handle positions, shelf positions and object placement.
 - Do not add, remove, move, resize, extend, shrink, straighten or redesign any object or architectural element, and do not invent absent cabinets, doors, appliances, plumbing fixtures, shelves or light fixtures.{GEOMETRY_SENTENCE}
 - Apply finishes according to the mask codes and material specifications. Where specifications overlap, follow the precedence rules below.
 - Objects cut off by the frame stay cut off, and nothing cut off is revealed further. Apply the finishes and lighting only to the corresponding existing regions, following the colour matching rules and finish specifications. Where specifications overlap, the more specific rule wins. Use the mask REGION MAP solely to locate surfaces boundaries; The final image must not contain mask hues, wireframes, line art, or flat-color mask styling.

. Parisian Bistro Balcony: Through the existing floor-to-ceiling multi-panel sliding doors, transform the outdoor area into a classic Parisian Bistro Balcony overlooking a romantic city street view. The floor features traditional monochrome black-and-white checkered tile pavers. An authentic French bistro dining setup is arranged outside, complete with a round cast-iron café table and two classic woven rattan bistro chairs. The balcony edge is defined by a delicate, ornate black wrought-iron railing lined with stone window boxes overflowing with pink geraniums and lush green ivy. Match the balcony light to [LIGHTING_MODE], casting soft, ambient city daylight across the balcony glass doors.

. PTokyo Cyber-Minimalist Terrace: Through the existing floor-to-ceiling multi-panel sliding doors, reveal an ultra-modern Tokyo Cyber-Minimalist Penthouse Terrace overlooking a sprawling, ultra-dense modern city skyline filled with sleek glass towers. The terrace features seamless, polished dark-gray obsidian stone slabs and a frameless structural glass balustrade railing that keeps the panoramic city view completely unobstructed. A long, architectural low-profile outdoor dining table crafted from sandblasted matte black aluminum is arranged cleanly on the deck, accented by a single sculptural Japanese pine tree in a raw concrete trough. Match the courtyard light to [LIGHTING_MODE], casting sharp, linear shadows and cool, high-key ambient sky exposure across the kitchen floor.

. Manhattan Dusk Skyline Terrace: Through the existing floor-to-ceiling multi-panel sliding doors, reveal a breathtaking Manhattan Dusk Skyline Penthouse Terrace overlooking iconic, sharply detailed skyscrapers fading into a soft, hazy atmospheric background. The expansive terrace features premium, wide-format light gray granite tile pavers and an elegant minimalist black metal protective railing. A long, structural charcoal-toned concrete outdoor dining table is centered on the deck, surrounded by neatly arranged low-profile modern chairs and a few structural green boxwood planters. Match the courtyard light to [LIGHTING_MODE], streaming a rich, cinematic twilight glow and dramatic horizontal linear window-frame shadows deep into the room layout.

. Miami Coastal Luxury Terrace: Through the existing floor-to-ceiling multi-panel sliding doors, reveal an expansive, sun-drenched Miami Coastal Luxury Penthouse Terrace overlooking a distant, glittering turquoise ocean coastline and a blurred palm-lined horizon. The terrace floor features pristine, seamless white-travertine stone tiles and an invisible, frameless glass structural balustrade. A large, minimal outdoor dining table crafted from weathered white teak wood is set up elegantly on the deck, framed by low concrete planters holding lush, glossy tropical bird of paradise leaves. Match the courtyard light to [LIGHTING_MODE], casting an intensely bright, high-key, airy daylight exposure with soft, diffused coastal shadows across the floor.

. Milanese Architectural Rooftop Garden: Through the existing floor-to-ceiling multi-panel sliding doors, reveal a highly refined Milanese Architectural Penthouse Terrace overlooking a historic yet contemporary European city skyline. The sprawling terrace combines premium, warm natural ipe wood decking with geometric sections of smooth raked river stone. A sleek, minimal outdoor dining table in matte charcoal steel is cleanly tucked underneath a minimalist black pergola, surrounded by curated layered greenery, ornamental grasses, and structural low-profile shrubs in light-grey concrete troughs. Match the courtyard light to [LIGHTING_MODE], throwing soft, sun-dappled daylight and delicate, crisp foliage shadows across the interior kitchen floor.
